root_causes.live_enrichment_crash: itinerary-validator.js calls item.vehicleFit?.includes(vehicle), while 1924/1925 overnight-accommodation.js writes vehicleFit:true for named accommodation. Optional chaining protects null/undefined only; it still tries .includes on boolean true, producing the exact runtime error shown by the user.
root_causes.missing_map_pois: The crash occurs in derivePlanState/validatePlan after POI and accommodation enrichment but before the final renderRoadtripMap call. Therefore the map remains on the earlier route-only render and never receives the enriched recommendation markers.
root_causes.base_route_straight_lines: The live OSRM base-daytrip can exceed maxDrive. validateBaseTrip treated drive-limit as a roadtrip-structure violation. ensureMultiDayRoadtripProgression then rejected the otherwise valid live plan and rebuilt the base trip with canonical straight geometry. Max-drive is already independently enforced by constraint-engine, so it does not belong in structural roadtrip validation.
root_causes.first_pending_position: The first overlay is opened directly from the form while Android can still have a focused input/transitioning visual viewport. The later overlay normally opens after focus has gone. Positioning against 100dvh can therefore put the first card too high relative to the actually visible viewport.

changes.validator: vehicleFit now supports array, string, boolean and absent metadata; generic external fallbacks are treated as unknown rather than incompatible.
changes.accommodation: named accommodation now writes vehicleFit as [trip.transport] instead of boolean true; generic search links use null.
changes.poi_rendering: removing the validator exception allows the existing final renderRoadtripMap step to render resolved POIs and accommodations.
changes.base_route: roadtrip-policy now validates topology/structure only. Drive-time excess remains a constraint violation, but does not cause live road geometry to be discarded/rebuilt.
changes.pending: submit blurs the active input and the overlay is positioned using window.visualViewport offset/height. A class-only observer repositions it when shown; it does not observe the whole document.

verification.map_render_path_source_verified: current app calls derivePlanState then renderRoadtripMap after enrichment; removing the validator exception restores that path
